name: SoundRace
title: Which phone heard it first?
full: Arm the microphones, make one comfortable sound, and rank which phone detected it first. Deltas are milliseconds between each phone’s own clock. A one-second ambient sample can suggest a detection threshold. It does not measure acoustic delay and it does not guarantee detection.
